name: escalate_to_flex
description: Escalate the active WhatsApp conversation to a Twilio Flex human agent. Use this only when the customer asks for a human, the issue is outside bot scope, or the conversation cannot be safely resolved by automation.

request_body_schema.description: Payload sent to the Twilio relay when the WhatsApp customer needs a human. Dynamic variables identify the Twilio Conversation, and LLM-generated fields provide concise escalation context for Flex.

intent.description: Snake_case routing intent, such as billing_dispute, account_access, technical_support, complaint, or general_support.

reason.description: Snake_case escalation reason, such as explicit_human_request, bot_cannot_resolve, customer_frustrated, sensitive_request, or policy_required.

summary.description: Concise handoff summary for the human Flex agent. Include the customer's goal, what the bot already tried, and any important details. Keep it under 500 characters.

priority.description: Optional routing priority from 0 to 10. Use 5 for normal priority and higher values for urgent or frustrated customers.
